attributes.board_name: Nevada Speech-Language Pathology, Audiology and Hearing Aid Dispensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by IIHIS/International Hearing Society, AAA, ASHA, Academy of Doctors of Audiology or Educational Audiology Association are deemed Board-approved. Also accepted: courses by universities, school districts, hospitals or similar; workshops, seminars, demonstrations, meetings, lectures; Internet courses; presentations (preparation max 50% of presentation hours, max 8 h per licensing period); publications (max 8 h); planned clinical observation with prior Board approval. Other CE by written request before renewal.
rules.new_licensee_rule: A person licensed within 12 months after graduating from a Board-approved accredited program needs no CE before the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE is provided to the Board with the application (NAC 637B.0355); keep receipts, attendance records and certificates at least 3 years. The Board conducts random audits.

topics.who: All licensees: at least 1 hour in ethics, cultural competence, cultural humility, culturally responsive practices or diversity, equity and inclusion (any one of these)

rules.notes: Standard and provisional licenses expire 1 year after issuance; 10 hours must be completed in the annual period immediately preceding renewal and must directly pertain to the licensed profession. Dispensing audiologists: at least 3 of the 10 hours on fitting and dispensing hearing aids. Inactive licensees must meet the same CE. Unfulfilled hours waived for extenuating circumstances are added to the next year. Nevada does not license SLP assistants under NRS 637B. The Board's own website could not be reached; board_url points to the official NAC chapter.
rules.rule_quote: …as a prerequisite for each renewal of a standard license or provisional license, a licensee must complete, during the annual period immediately preceding the renewal, at least 10 hours of continuing education approved by the Board that directly pertains to the profession in which he or she holds a license issued by the Board,…
